entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, Agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse I just bought. I'm hoping I can still return it. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, it's just... not what I needed. And I feel awful because I honestly tried to return it last week, well within the 10 days. I really needed that money back for a bill.
Okay, I see. So it's a preference issue. You mentioned you tried to return it last week. Can you tell me what happened?

Yes, I went online a few days ago, I think it was my 9th day with it, and there was a huge website error. The whole return portal seemed to be down. The system down message just stayed there, and I couldn't print the return label or anything. I even took a screenshot.

I understand. Let me pull up your account here... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 13 days ago. And you are correct, I can see a note here that we had a known system outage that day. I'm sorry you were affected by that.
I was just so worried I'd be stuck with it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was counting on that refund.
Well, please don't worry about it. After checking our policy, it looks like you're perfectly fine anyway. All VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? 90 days? So... so it's not a problem that I'm at day 13?

Not a problem at all. You have plenty of time. I've gone ahead and authorized the return for you now. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. Just pack the band back in its original box and use that label to send it back for a full refund.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea how much this helps.
It's my pleasure to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
